CustomField.description: If true, the public form renders this field on the same visual row as the immediately preceding active field within the same section (side by side, 2 fields per row), instead of stacked on its own line. Purely a layout hint for dataUpdateForm — has no effect on validation, submission, or history. Ignored (field renders on its own row) if the preceding field is itself already paired with another one.
CustomField.label: Same Row As Previous
